title: Memory run
description: One line of the memory ledger's run log, runs.jsonl. Every job records one, including a rejected or failed one, so an empty memory can be told apart from a memory whose rewrite was refused (protocol evidence-gate). 'dropped_by_provenance' is how many claims the evidence gate removed because they cited no id the judge was shown. Jobs may add fields of their own, so the object stays open.

status.description: 'ok' was written; 'rejected' passed parsing but failed the gate and left the previous state in place; 'failed' produced nothing usable.
